title: Units Whose Windows Enter the Average Daily Use — PAP Therapy Equipment
content:
# Units Whose Windows Enter the Average Daily Use — PAP Therapy Equipment

**Records standard.** The average daily use stated on a PAP Therapy Equipment usage summary averages only the downloaded windows of the units that count, and which windows are averaged follows the units that have stood in the home:

1. on a record with a **malfunction swap**, only the windows downloaded from the serial now on the record are averaged;
2. on a record with a **loaner delivery and no swap**, every window except those downloaded from the loaner's serial is averaged;
3. on any other record, every window is averaged.

Each window averaged counts once: the average is the windows' average hours per 24 hours, summed, divided by the number of windows averaged. Where no window remains to be averaged, the average is 0.0 hours.

**Where it is read.** Swaps and loaners are deliveries in the device's service history whose purpose is a malfunction swap or a loaner. Each downloaded 30-night compliance window carries the serial number of the unit it was downloaded from. The serial now on the record is the one on the PAP Therapy Equipment device record; the loaner's serial is the serial on the loaner delivery (the latest one, where there is more than one).

## Worked scopes (hypothetical windows)

Windows on the record: 3.2 hours from serial A, 2.0 hours from serial L (a loaner), 4.6 hours from serial B.

| Record shows | Serial now on the record | Windows averaged | Average |
|---|---|---|---|
| a malfunction swap from A to B | B | B | 4.6 |
| a loaner L, no swap | A | A and B | 3.9 |
| neither | A | A, L and B | 3.2667 |

The average is carried unrounded into the stated figure.
